_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for every mention of the class-recording libraries on the site.
Facts below were stated by the owner on 2026-08-06 and must not be embellished:
the libraries REQUIRE a Google sign-in (never say 'no sign-up'), some classes are in
English and some in Hindi, they are updated frequently, and a viewer should watch a
class end to end. Recording durations and per-lesson lists are NOT known here; do not
invent them. Group and individual: the open libraries are recordings of real group
classes; one-to-one recordings exist but are shared on request only.
access: Free to watch. No payment, no card, just a quick Google sign-in.
format: Full recordings of real, unedited live classes
interaction: Recordings of real group classes: you see the mentor and students interacting, but the recording is not live and cannot interact with you.
languages: Some classes are in English and some in Hindi; everyone follows at their own pace.
updated: Updated frequently with the latest classes and the current teaching style.
watchTip: Watch a class end to end, like you are in it. Sessions are interactive and each moment builds on the last.
device: Best watched on a computer or laptop for a smooth, clear experience.
howToWatch: Open the library on a computer or laptop.
Click the library button, then choose "Watch Recording" on the page that opens.
Sign in with Google and wait a few seconds.
The recording dashboard opens with all the recordings.
sample_note: These recordings show how we teach, not the exact syllabus of this course.

libraries.name: Kids coding library
libraries.label: Watch a Kids Class (6 to 12)
libraries.audience: Children aged 6 to 12 and their parents
libraries.whatYouSee: A mentor explaining one idea at a time with visual examples, children building something in the session, questions answered as they come up, and progress checked before moving on.

libraries.name: Teens and adults library
libraries.label: Watch a Teens & Adults Class (13+)
libraries.audience: Teens, college students and working professionals; also covers maths
libraries.whatYouSee: Concepts built up step by step, code written and debugged live, students explaining their reasoning, and problems solved together rather than handed over.
